scenes.text: How did one passer break two leagues?
Kevin De Bruyne dominates modern football passing as one of the premier playmakers of his generation.
Before coming to England, he stormed Germany with standout playmaking abilities.
In Germany, he set an all-time record with 21 assists in one season.
Then in England, he matched the Premier League record with 20.
His elite vision helped power Manchester City's dominant attack.
That precision helped City achieve a historic 100-point league season.
He has collected six league titles and three Playmaker of the Season awards.
He stands among the most consistent assist providers in Premier League history.
His record-breaking genius consistently creates high-quality chances against top defenses.
